original_record.question:
A square is divided into 25 small squares (see the picture). Find the measure of the angle which is the sum of the angles $M A N, M B N, M C N, M D N, M E N$.
<image1>
original_record.subject: combinatorial geometry

inventory.dashed_connectors: M and N to every top label; N-A coincides with grid edge

answer_verification.method: Angle at top coordinate i equals arctan(i/5)-arctan((i-1)/5). Sum telescopes to arctan1=45degrees.
